about.heading: Get Your Favorite Food Delivered
paragraphs: Louisiana-Style Mexican Seafood Delight is a vibrant and flavorful seafood dish that celebrates the coastal flavors of Mexico. Fresh seafood is seasoned with traditional Mexican spices, cooked to tender perfection, and complemented by a blend of rich, smoky flavors that evoke the essence of Mexico’s seaside cuisine. Garnished with bright, zesty toppings and served with a side of Mexican-style slaw, this dish brings a refreshing taste of the ocean to your plate. It’s a culinary experience that captures the heart of Mexican seafood cooking in every savory bite.

Molcajete Perrón is a true showstopper of Mexican cuisine, served sizzling in a traditional stone mortar that locks in its bold, smoky flavors. This hearty dish features a rich variety of perfectly grilled meats, such as tender steak, juicy chicken, and succulent shrimp, all marinated in a savory blend of spices that bring out their natural flavors. Layered with grilled cactus, onions, and bell peppers, and topped with bubbling melted cheese, it’s a feast for the senses. Finished with a side of fresh guacamole, salsa, and warm tortillas, the Molcajete Perrón invites you to create your own perfect bites. With every mouthful, you’ll savor the essence of Mexico’s most cherished flavors, blending warmth, spice, and tradition in every bite.
Don't feel like cooking today? We got you covered - order now!

reviews.text:
This staff and atmosphere is just super awesome! They fast clean and have it all together! Stephanie is the one  + the bar man who supported the 2 bdays we had ☺️ I now have a “go to” for Mexican that’s all you need drinks ✔️ food and decor for a decent price and portion with lots of parking 🅿️ & not in a sketchy spot okay 👌🏽

Thank you so very much muchas gracias 😊!!! Hasta Luego

I was visiting family in Charlotte North Carolina. My friend wholeness down there recommend this place. It definitely didn't disappoint. The food was delicious,  the atmosphere was amazing,as you can see the decor was beautiful. There was a line to take pictures in this lovely area. I can't wait to go back and try more dishes.

Fantastic Mexican restaurant. I had the Gemelos Burritos and it was great. Lots of food, too. The vibe was nice and not too many people. Staff was friendly and attentive.
I am a big fan of Casa Azul, but this might be my new go-to Mexican place. I hear I need to try the Sunday buffet.

By far the worst!!!! I used to love eating here the food quality has went down tremendously!!! The customer service is horrible!! I ordered 2 orders of 3 grilled chicken tacos with cilantro n onions the meat was skimped and stretched, there was more cilantro than meat!! And most importantly the wood plate was dirty with white residue. I told them I’m writing a review he said he didn’t care just pay the tab!!! Very DISAPPOINTED!!!

Oh and I asked for a discount and they refused!!!

I would give zero stars just on the fact that I specifically told them I’m allergic to mushrooms can we make sure that nothing get in my food and sure enough I have mushrooms in my food (which don’t come with it). Tried called 8 times and no answer (probably due to close to closing). No food wasted $30+. The lady up front was super sweet though.

signatures.body: A true showstopper of Mexican cuisine, served sizzling in a traditional stone mortar that locks in its bold, smoky flavors. Tender steak, juicy chicken and succulent shrimp with grilled cactus, onions and peppers, topped with bubbling melted cheese, finished with fresh guacamole, salsa and warm tortillas.
signatures.name: Molcajete Perrón

signatures.body: A vibrant seafood dish that celebrates the coastal flavors of Mexico. Fresh seafood seasoned with traditional Mexican spices, cooked to tender perfection and complemented by rich, smoky notes, garnished with bright, zesty toppings and a side of Mexican-style slaw. A refreshing taste of the ocean in every savory bite.
signatures.name: Seafood Delight, Louisiana-Style
